label: UNDERSTANDING HIM

points.heading: Ask instead of assuming
points.body: A simple question beats hours of overthinking.
points.panel: “What did you mean when you said that?”

points.heading: Notice his actions over time
points.body: Patterns say more than any single message.
points.panel: Look at the last month, not the last text.

points.heading: Learn how he shows care
points.body: Some people show love through doing, not saying.
points.panel: “How do you usually show people you care?”

points.heading: Share how you feel too
points.body: Openness from you invites openness from him.
points.panel: “I really enjoyed tonight. I like spending time with you.”

resource.name: His Secret Obsession
resource.covers: Ideas for understanding attraction and emotional connection.

caption:
It’s easy to spend hours decoding a text or a mood. Understanding someone usually comes from simpler things: asking, noticing, and sharing.

These four habits help. If you’d like ideas for understanding attraction and emotional connection, there’s a resource at the link in bio. It’s a place to start, and no resource can promise how another person will feel.

Follow @roundabloom for more.
